name: 「出しっぱなし」裁判、開廷します(再制作版)

p_40eef2ab0e.sentence: Maybe it is time to blow the whistle on that game.
p_40eef2ab0e.prev: When you are hungry, why play extra time until the counter is empty?

p_c9d3934b22.sentence: Even so, must we move every pen and toy before we eat?
p_c9d3934b22.prev: But there is still room to put plates down.
p_c9d3934b22.next: In one home in a New Zealand study, the counter had three uses.

p_167dfe5e4a.sentence: It is about getting ready for what you want to do next.
p_167dfe5e4a.prev: The idea is not to treat tidying as a contest to “get rid of everything.”
p_167dfe5e4a.next: The paper says many people in the study were found through LinkedIn.

p_97a59c5492.sentence: The paper also says the results may not fit people with different living conditions as well.
p_97a59c5492.prev: They had a high level of education, and most came from middle- to upper-middle-class homes.
p_97a59c5492.next: So the lesson is not a rule that “this way is right.”

p_ef141c4825.sentence: This does not mean you never need to tidy up.
p_ef141c4825.prev: If the answer is “We can eat here,” perhaps we can call it good enough for today.
p_ef141c4825.next: It means choosing where to stop.

p_8fd9d046ad.prev: It is the kind of sight that makes you want to shout.

p_8a08062899.sentence: But if the goal is “being able to eat here,” must you move a toy that is not in the way of a plate?
p_8a08062899.prev: If the goal is “empty,” then everything must go.
p_8a08062899.next: The same counter can have a new goal.

p_aa68f9a3b4.sentence: This is not a scorecard where an empty counter gets 100 points and a pen left behind loses points.
p_aa68f9a3b4.prev: It is where we say, “This is good enough.”
p_aa68f9a3b4.next: The story shows this home has a clear rule: “If there is room to eat, the rest can stay.”
